reason: A DeepSeek Harness compatibility utility that neutralizes the functional effects of dsh-claude-ux while preserving its displayed enabled state; human review is warranted because it bypasses risk controls and intentionally spoofs status information.

summaries.zh: 用于兼容 DeepSeek Harness 的 dsh-claude-ux，抑制其区域限制、分类请求和输入框接管等行为，同时保留设置页显示的启用状态。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness compatibility utility that suppresses dsh-claude-ux behavior such as regional blocking, classification requests, and composer takeover while preserving its displayed enabled state.

capabilities: Intercepts and rewrites same-origin status requests
Modifies persisted plugin settings before host submission
Patches plugin bundle behavior and system prompt sections
Suppresses a named classification request with local results
Restores a chat input UI state after takeover behavior
Reinvokes the real model for selected synthetic responses
